requires.label: Patient must be a resident of New Hampshire or Vermont
requires.quote: a. Patient must be a resident of New Hampshire or Vermont, except instances where presumptive charity guidelines are used.

rules.label: Standard Application: 100% charity for income ≤225% FPL
rules.quote: To be eligible for 100% approval for the Valley Regional Hospital Financial Assistance Program, family income must be less than or equal to 225% of the Federal Poverty Income Guidelines.

rules.label: Standard Application: 75% charity for income 226%-250% FPL
rules.quote: To be eligible for 75% approval for the Valley Regional Hospital Financial Assistance Program, family income must be between 226%-250% of the Federal Poverty Income Guidelines.

rules.label: Standard Application: 50% charity for income 251%-275% FPL
rules.quote: To be eligible for 50% approval for the Valley Regional Hospital Financial Assistance Program, family income must be between 251%-275% of the Federal Poverty Income Guidelines.

rules.label: Standard Application: 25% charity for income 276%-300% FPL
rules.quote: To be eligible for 25% approval for the Valley Regional Hospital Financial Assistance Program, family income must be between 276%-300% of the Federal Poverty Income Guidelines.

rules.label: Uninsured discount applied prior to financial assistance
rules.quote: For fiscal year FY25-10/1/24-9/30/25 the discount determined as above it 45%.

notes: Eligibility may be determined via Standard Application Process, Presumptive Eligibility, or ED Quick Application (for patients outside catchment area >30 miles, not seen at VRH/VRH-owned practice, who sign attestation).

Assets include savings, certificates of deposit, checking, IRAs, stocks, bonds, 401Ks, mutual funds; sheltered assets: up to $5,000 per person/$10,000 per family in savings/CDs/checking; equity in primary residence up to $100,000 ($150,000 for applicants aged 55 or older).
Patients receiving financial assistance must reapply at 6-month intervals; those on fixed incomes (e.g., social security) must reapply annually.
Appeals process: patient may appeal denial within 30 days by writing to Director of Revenue Cycle; final decision within 30 days of receipt of appeal request.

Hospital will not impose extraordinary collection actions without first making reasonable efforts to determine financial assistance eligibility; exceptions require approval by Revenue Cycle Director and/or CFO.
Refunds: if patient pays outstanding balance and subsequently submits approved Financial Assistance Application, hospital will refund any amount paid for the care.
Excluded services: Elective cosmetic procedures, Hearing Aids and repairs, DOT Examinations, Sports Physicals, Gait Analysis, Dry Needling (see Exhibit A).

Providers accepting VRH Financial Assistance: All employed providers of VRH including VRH-owned physician clinics (Associates in Medicine, Valley Primary Care, Valley Regional Orthopedics, Valley Regional Surgical Associates, Valley Regional Urology, Valley Regional Womens’ Health); independent providers Dartmouth Hitchcock, Medstream Anesthesia LLC, BlueWater Emergency Partners. Providers not accepting: any area independent provider group (e.g., Keady Family Practice, Charlestown Family Medicine).
Upon applicant’s request, VRH will share application and supporting documentation with any hospital the applicant requests.
req_residency may leave out a condition: Residency requirement has an exception for presumptive charity guidelines.
